# SOC 2 Type I Audit

Our first SOC 2 examination: a Type I report from Ashcombe Assurance, needed because the Meridale contract made one a condition with a 2026-09-30 deadline. Completed on 2026-08-28 with two exceptions.

## Outcome

A SOC 2 Type I report on the Security, Availability and Confidentiality criteria, issued by Ashcombe Assurance before 2026-09-30, that we can share with Meridale and other enterprise prospects under NDA. Reached on 2026-08-28.

## Current State

- Report issued 2026-08-28, as of 2026-07-31 ([[soc2-type-1-report]]). Meridale received it on 2026-09-02 through [[samir-haddad]].
- Two exceptions: the quarterly access review had no completed, evidenced cycle; one leaver's laptop came back without a wipe record. Both are in [[soc2-exceptions-remediation-plan]].
- Work continues in [[soc2-type-2-observation]]; this project is closed.

## Scope and Boundaries

In scope: the Quaylane production system (the four repositories, AWS production account, RDS, the job queue, Pingrove as a subprocessor), the people who can change it, and the company processes that touch it (onboarding, offboarding, vendor review). Out of scope: Processing Integrity and Privacy criteria, which Patrice advised we skip for a first report. Corporate laptops are in scope only as far as offboarding and disk encryption.

## Working Context

We chose a Type I first because a Type II needs a three to twelve month observation window, and Meridale's deadline did not leave room for one ([[soc2-type-1-vs-type-2]]). We ran it on a spreadsheet control matrix and a shared evidence folder instead of buying a compliance platform ([[should-we-buy-a-compliance-automation-platform]], [[a-spreadsheet-is-enough-for-a-first-soc-2]]). Total external cost was $38,500: Ashcombe's fee of $24,500 plus the [[bracken-hollow-pen-test-report-2026]] at $14,000.

The change management control is the one engineering felt most: one recorded approval per pull request, decided at [[engineering-meeting-2026-04-08]], with [[patrice-ndour]]'s position that pairing alone is not evidence. Break-glass changes follow [[ship-an-emergency-change]].
